title: Chemical Guys Big Noodle Supersized Wash Mitt for Car Washing, Ultra-Soft Microfiber Noodles for Scratch-Free Finish on Paint, Glass, and Trim, Safe for Cars, Trucks, and SUVs - 2 Pack
description: Chemical Guys Big Noodle Supersized Wash Mitt comes in a 2-pack so you always have a clean one ready. The oversized mitt features deep microfiber noodle fingers designed to hold a large volume of soapy water per pass while trapping and lifting surface dirt away from paint rather than dragging it across the finish.The noodle construction is the key to how this mitt works. Each finger holds soap and water deep in its structure, releasing it across the paint surface in a thick, lubricated layer as you wash. That lubrication is what separates a swirl-inducing wipe from a safe, scratch-free wash pass. Dirt particles get lifted into the noodles rather than dragged along the surface, reducing the micro-abrasion that builds up into visible swirl marks over time on dark paint.The mitt is generously sized to fit over most hand sizes comfortably, with an elastic cuff that stays secure while scrubbing, wringing, and reloading. Ultra-soft microfiber glides across paint, clear coat, glass, chrome, and trim without scratching any surface when used with proper car wash soap and technique.Having two mitts in the pack gives you options. Use one exclusively on painted panels and the other on wheels, lower rockers, and door jambs where contamination levels are higher. Rotate between washes so one is always clean and dry. Keep a spare in your detail bag for mobile work. Both mitts rinse clean after use and handle machine washing without losing softness or shedding fibers. Pair with Chemical Guys Mr. Pink or Maxi Suds car wash soap for best results.
